description: File type vs leading bytes (magic numbers, disguised HTML, truncation) — Compares a claimed file type (MIME type and/or file name) with the first bytes of the file, for an agent that is about to open, parse or forward a download. Detects PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, ZIP and OOXML (docx/xlsx/pptx), GZIP, PDF, MP4 (ftyp), ELF, PE, RAR, BMP, ICO and HTML, flags an HTML login or error page saved as a PDF/image/archive, and reports truncation from end-of-file markers when the last

claimedName.description: File name or path; the last extension is the claim.

complete.description: True when head is the entire file; end-of-file markers are then checked on it.

head.description: Standard padded base64 of the first bytes of the file (up to 32768 bytes decoded).

tail.description: Optional base64 of the last bytes (up to 4096 decoded), used for end-of-file markers when head is not the whole file.

totalSize.description: Optional total file size in bytes, for size-field comparisons (RIFF, MP4 boxes, ZIP directory).

name: magic-bytes
